name: aici-engine
description: Headless browser telemetry engine that captures console logs, uncaught runtime exceptions and failed network requests from a target URL, in desktop or mobile mode.

tools.name: run_audit
tools.description: Load a public URL in an isolated headless Chromium (desktop or mobile), capture console logs, runtime errors and failed network requests, and return a structured diagnostic report.

parameters.name: targetUrl
parameters.description: Full http(s) URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Device mode to emulate: desktop (default) or mobile.

credentials.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
credentials.description: Google Gemini API key used for AI diagnosis of captured errors.
